Twenty comments

The Ragged Hank Of Yarn (reel)

There are many similar-sounding reels, but this is yet another unique variant of “Eel in the Sink”: https://thesession.org/tunes/1446 Bobbey Casey plays it on “Paddy in the Smoke” CD, and East Galway fiddler Breda Keville recently recorded it as a tribute to the West Clare fiddler.

This transcription is basically a composite of the versions played by the two fiddlers, with some notes changed to suit my fancy. Hope nobody will complain. You can also play it a double reel.

↳ Posted by slainte on May 17th, 2007.

Compare “The Old Man’s Blackthorn Stick,” another variant of “Eel in the Sink”: https://thesession.org/tunes/5774

↳ Posted by slainte on May 17th, 2007.

How can you have “another unique” variant ? :)

↳ Posted by Kenny on May 17th, 2007.

“another mutant eel in the sink”…

↳ Posted by slainte on May 17th, 2007.

“How can you have ”another unique“ variant ?”

How can a variant be anything but *unique*? If it were the same as another one, it wouldn’t be a *variant*.

So, you’re both wrong.

And I’m right.
